candidates.change_summary: Pass jojoTeam instead of msg.sender as the new oracle's owner, so the deployed oracle has a different owner.
Emit jojoTeam instead of msg.sender in the NewEmergencyOracle event, changing the observable event payload.
Remove the onlyJojoTeam modifier so any caller can create an emergency oracle.
Invert the access check so the function reverts for the JOJO team and succeeds for all other callers.
